title: What can I still do?
notes: Rain Day's encounter, in the morning. Only the floor version is possible. The voice uses the no-daily-minimum argument. Claude's draft.
Resting on purpose counts as the floor today. Rest is never penalized; the question is restoring or hiding.

tag.item: Resilience: What can I still do?

intro: Rain. A head cold. The day's plan is gone.
open: You're sick. No way you're doing the full thing. So skip it.
rounds: No time for the full thing, so skip it.
Rest all day. Rest on the phone. Rest at the bar. It's all rest.

pushback.name-it: It's not hiding. It's one night.
pushback.remove-access: One beer was never the problem.
pushback.remember-why: That's a nice idea. You're tired.
pushback.plan-change: See? Even you think it's a plan change.
pushback.floor: You're sick. Ten minutes is ten minutes too many.

answers.floor: So the ten minutes looks different today.
answers.waiting: Sick is real. It changes the plan. It doesn't cancel the floor.

floorExtra.label: Rest on purpose: soup, water, phone in the kitchen, bed by 9
floorExtra.record: Floor, the sick version: rested on purpose.

floorExtra.label: Walk to the mailbox and back, in the rain
text: It's not ten minutes. It's the version of ten minutes you have.
floorExtra.record: Floor, the sick version: walked to the mailbox and back.

floorExtra.label: Five minutes on the kitchen, then the couch
text: Dishes in the rack. That's it.
floorExtra.record: Floor, the sick version: five minutes on the kitchen.

floorExtra.label: [Deshawn]'s three moves, slow
text: One round, slow. He'd tell you that counts.
floorExtra.record: Floor, the sick version: [Deshawn]'s moves, slow.

acted.label: Acted
text: The floor, the sick version. It counts.
"What can I still do?" turned out to be the whole question.

adjusted.label: Adjusted
text: The facts changed: rain, a fever. The plan changes with them: today the floor is rest, on purpose.
adjusted.record: Changed the plan: sick and rained out. Rested on purpose.

delayed.label: Delayed
text: You put all of it off. Being sick is a real reason to change the plan. It wasn't a reason to drop the floor. The floor today was rest, on purpose.
delayed.record: Put it off to tomorrow. Sick.

phone.label: Escaped
text: You lie there with the phone and the rain. Hours go. It felt like rest. It wasn't, quite.
Tomorrow opens with the restart sequence. It's a way back, not a punishment.
effects: record:{time}. Still in bed with the phone.

drink.label: Escaped
text: Beer and cold medicine. You know better. It worked for an hour.
Tomorrow opens with the restart sequence. It's a way back, not a punishment.

comfort.label: Escaped
text: Delivery, blankets, six episodes. Some of that was rest. You can't tell which part.
Tomorrow opens with the restart sequence. It's a way back, not a punishment.
